# Analysis in R 


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(skimr)
library(zoo)
library(knitr)
library(ggridges)
library(patchwork)
library(gifski)
library(gganimate)

setwd("/Users/samcooper/Documents/GitHub/project-writeup-graham-and-sam")

qual_pca_nute = read_parquet("shared_data/cluster_pca_map_5_clusters_no_alcohol_nutrient_household_nutrient_per_total_cal_234_inits.parquet")


gor_to_ihme = c(
  "1"  = "North East England",
  "2"  = "North West England",
  "4"  = "Yorkshire and the Humber",
  "5"  = "East Midlands",
  "6"  = "West Midlands",
  "7"  = "East of England",
  "8"  = "Greater London",
  "9"  = "South East England",
  "10" = "South West England",
  "11" = "Wales",
  "12" = "Scotland",
  "13" = "Northern Ireland")



qual_pca_nute = qual_pca_nute %>%
  mutate(
    ihme_region = gor_to_ihme[as.character(gor)])

```



```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# >>> SET YOUR INPUT VARIABLES HERE <
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

data_source   = qual_pca_nute        # dataset with hhno, styr, gor, cluster, PC1_score, PC2_score, PC3_score
cluster_col   = "cluster"       # fixed column name in this dataset # used for stacked bar, gif and 
label_name    = "Nutrients"          # — used in titles/filenames # used in all
analysis_type = "Composition"   # used in all
year_col      = "styr"  # used in all
value_cols    = c("PC1_score", "PC2_score")   # loop through PC1 and PC2 # needed for ridge/boxplot
region_col    = "ihme_gor"  # part of the uk # needed for by region plots
```


```{r}
## Composition fg 17, then nute, the corresponding dataset will need to be switched

save_dir = "output_plots"
dir.create(save_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prep data
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_data1 = data_source %>%
  select(hhno, all_of(year_col), all_of(cluster_col)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_col]]))

cluster_props1 = cluster_data1 %>%
  group_by(.data[[year_col]], .data[[cluster_col]]) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(.data[[year_col]]) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    proportion = n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(.data[[year_col]], .data[[cluster_col]])

print(kable(cluster_props1, digits = 3))


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stacked bar chart — cluster proportions by year
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

p_trend = ggplot(
  cluster_props1,
  aes(x = factor(.data[[year_col]]), y = proportion, fill = factor(.data[[cluster_col]]))
) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = paste0(label_name, " Cluster Proportions (", analysis_type, ") by Year"),
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Proportion of Households",
    fill = paste0(label_name, " Cluster")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

print(p_trend)
ggsave(
  file.path(save_dir, paste0(label_name, "_", tolower(analysis_type), "_stacked_bar.png")),
  p_trend, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 150
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Line plot — cluster proportion trends over time
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

p_trend_line = ggplot(
  cluster_props1,
  aes(x = .data[[year_col]], y = proportion, color = factor(.data[[cluster_col]]))
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(label_name, " Cluster Proportion (", analysis_type, ") Trends by Year"),
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Proportion of Households",
    color = paste0(label_name, " Cluster")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_trend_line)
ggsave(
  file.path(save_dir, paste0(label_name, "_", tolower(analysis_type), "_trend_line.png")),
  p_trend_line, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 150
)
```


```{r}
## qual pca box and ridge map for fg17. fg55, nute pc1 values


save_dir = "output_plots"
dir.create(save_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

all_stats = list()

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loop through PC1_score and PC2_score
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

for (value_col in value_cols) {

  cat("\n\n########## ", value_col, " ##########\n")

  # ---- Prep data ----
  plot_data = data_source %>%
    select(hhno, all_of(year_col), all_of(value_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[value_col]]))

  # ---- Stat table — summary by year ----
  var_stats = plot_data %>%
    group_by(.data[[year_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n      = n(),
      mean   = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      min    = min(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(variable = value_col, .before = 1)

  all_stats[[value_col]] = var_stats

  print(kable(var_stats, digits = 3))

  # ---- Ridge plot ----
  p_ridge = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = .data[[value_col]], y = factor(.data[[year_col]]), fill = factor(.data[[year_col]]))) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.3, color = "white") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(label_name, " ", value_col, " (", analysis_type, ") by Year"),
      x = value_col, y = "Survey Year", fill = "Year"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p_ridge)
  ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, paste0(label_name, "_", value_col, "_", tolower(analysis_type), "_ridge_by_year.png")),
    p_ridge, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 150
  )

  # ---- Box plot ----
  p_box = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(.data[[year_col]]), y = .data[[value_col]], fill = factor(.data[[year_col]]))) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(label_name, " ", value_col, " (", analysis_type, ") by Year"),
      x = "Survey Year", y = value_col, fill = "Year"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  print(p_box)
  ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, paste0(label_name, "_", value_col, "_", tolower(analysis_type), "_box_by_year.png")),
    p_box, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 150
  )
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combined stats table across PC1_score and PC2_score
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
data_source = qual_pca_nute    # your dataset
cluster_col = "cluster"        # categorical cluster membership (0:4)
year_col    = "styr"
label_name  = "nute"           # used in output labeling/filenames

save_dir = "output_plots"
dir.create(save_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prep data — counts and proportions per cluster per year
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_data = data_source %>%
  select(hhno, all_of(year_col), all_of(cluster_col)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_col]]))

cluster_props = cluster_data %>%
  group_by(.data[[year_col]], .data[[cluster_col]]) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(.data[[year_col]]) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), proportion = n / total) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(.data[[cluster_col]], .data[[year_col]])

print(kable(cluster_props, digits = 4))

clusters = sort(unique(cluster_props[[cluster_col]]))
years    = sort(unique(cluster_props[[year_col]]))

#Consecutive year-over-year proportion tests, PER CLUSTER
#(two-proportion z-test: is cluster K's share different between year A and year B?)

pairwise_results = list()

for (clust in clusters) {
  for (i in 2:length(years)) {

    yr_prev = years[i - 1]
    yr_curr = years[i]

    row_prev = cluster_props %>% filter(.data[[year_col]] == yr_prev, .data[[cluster_col]] == clust)
    row_curr = cluster_props %>% filter(.data[[year_col]] == yr_curr, .data[[cluster_col]] == clust)

    # Skip if cluster didn't appear at all in one of the two years
    if (nrow(row_prev) == 0 || nrow(row_curr) == 0) next

    n_success = c(row_prev$n, row_curr$n)
    n_total   = c(row_prev$total, row_curr$total)

    ptest = prop.test(n_success, n_total)

    pairwise_results[[paste0(clust, "_", yr_prev, "_vs_", yr_curr)]] = tibble(
      cluster        = clust,
      year_prev      = yr_prev,
      year_curr      = yr_curr,
      prop_prev      = row_prev$proportion,
      prop_curr      = row_curr$proportion,
      prop_change    = row_curr$proportion - row_prev$proportion,
      chi_sq         = unname(ptest$statistic),
      p_value        = ptest$p.value,
      significant    = ifelse(ptest$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
    )
  }
}

pairwise_table = bind_rows(pairwise_results) %>% arrange(cluster, year_prev)

cat("\n==== Year-over-Year Cluster Proportion Tests ====\n")
print(kable(pairwise_table, digits = 4))


# Trend test across ALL years, PER CLUSTER
# (Cochran-Armitage: is there a consistent up/down trend in this cluster's share across the full time span?)


trend_results = list()

for (clust in clusters) {

  clust_data = cluster_props %>% filter(.data[[cluster_col]] == clust) %>% arrange(.data[[year_col]])

  if (nrow(clust_data) < 3) next  # trend test needs several time points

  trend_test = prop.trend.test(clust_data$n, clust_data$total)

  trend_results[[as.character(clust)]] = tibble(
    cluster       = clust,
    n_years       = nrow(clust_data),
    first_year    = min(clust_data[[year_col]]),
    last_year     = max(clust_data[[year_col]]),
    prop_first    = clust_data$proportion[which.min(clust_data[[year_col]])],
    prop_last     = clust_data$proportion[which.max(clust_data[[year_col]])],
    chi_sq        = unname(trend_test$statistic),
    p_value       = trend_test$p.value,
    significant_trend = ifelse(trend_test$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  )
}

trend_table = bind_rows(trend_results)

cat("\n==== Overall Trend Test (Cochran-Armitage), Per Cluster ====\n")
print(kable(trend_table, digits = 4))
```
